prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:
[goal] First level of a Win95-flavored archery game in a single `game/index.html`: mouse aim, draw-for-power, balloons, score, start, lose.

[action] Built `game/index.html` (single file, canvas + WebAudio, no assets, only Google Fonts "Press Start 2P"). Sunset-butte scene, silhouette archer, hold-to-draw bow with flexing string, power bar, dotted trajectory preview that includes gravity and per-wave wind, arrows with trails and stuck shafts, glossy swaying balloons, confetti pop + balloon shred, floating score text, combo multiplier (x1-x5), screen shake and 45ms hit-stop on pop. All sound synthesized: rising creak while drawing, filtered-noise whoosh on release, pitched pop that rises with combo, escape thud, wave blip, game-over arpeggio. Win95 beveled panels for start/game-over, `C:\GAMES\SKYSHOT.EXE` titlebar, HUD chips, best score in localStorage. Three escaped balloons ends the run; waves grow in count, speed and wind.

[result] Verified live in the browser, not just by reading code:
- Start click → `mode:"play"`, balloons spawn and rise (screenshot shows them with highlights/strings).
- Scripted shot: direct aim undershoots by the gravity drop (arrow log shows the arc), corrected aim pops the balloon: `score:300, balloonsLeft:0, parts:17, combo:1`.
- Escape with 1 life left → `mode:"over"`, game-over panel shown, `final:"300"`.
- Screenshots confirmed fonts, HUD, bow shape, preview arc, power bar.
- Fixed during review: HUD leaked onto start screen (id beat `.hidden`), `♥`/`←` glyphs missing from Press Start 2P (replaced with LIVES count and ASCII `< WIND`), bow arc was a full halo.

Assumptions: endless escalating waves stand in for "level 1" content; 3 lives is the loss rule; unlimited arrows so skill is aim/lead, not ammo.

[open limits] Audio output itself was not ear-verified (headless playback), only that every sfx path executes without error. Browser tabs I opened are closed.
